orders.title: My orders
orders.emptyMsg: You haven't placed any orders. Start shopping to see them here.

success.msgConfirmed: Thank you for your order! We'll process it and deliver as soon as possible.
success.msgFailed: We could not confirm a successful payment. You can retry from My Orders or contact support.
success.msgReview: We received your payment but need to verify the amount. Our team will contact you shortly. Please do not pay again.
success.msgDelayed: We haven't received confirmation from the payment provider yet. Please don't pay again. We'll email you as soon as it's confirmed, and you can check My Orders at any time.
success.msgConfirming: Please wait while we confirm your payment with the provider. This usually takes a few seconds.

pay.pendingBody: The payment provider is still confirming your payment. You don't need to pay again; we'll update your order as soon as confirmation arrives. If the status doesn't update soon, please contact support.
pay.rejectedBody: The amount received for this order didn't match the total, so the payment was declined and the funds are being returned to the account you paid from. This can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 24 hours to reflect, depending on your bank.
pay.rejectedTotal: Your order total is {{total}}. When you're ready, you can retry with that exact amount.
pay.underBody: The transfer we received was less than your order total of {{total}}. Your order hasn't been processed yet. Our team is reviewing this and will be in touch, or you can contact support directly with your order number for a faster resolution.
pay.discBody: We're double-checking the details of this payment before processing your order. This is usually resolved quickly. No action is needed from you right now, but feel free to reach out if you don't hear back within a day.
pay.expiredBody: The payment window for this order closed before it was completed. No charge was made. You can start a new checkout for the same items whenever you're ready.
pay.extraBody: We received {{amount}} more than your order total. Your order is confirmed and being processed as normal. We'll be in touch about refunding or crediting the difference.
